name: Jonah Fischer
about_me: I'm Jonah, the recruiter at Routewise, a Detroit startup that routes delivery fleets. I'm hiring two embedded engineers and a summer intern class. I'm looking for strong student engineers and club leaders who can spread the word.
goals: Hire two embedded engineers for Routewise

debriefs.text: Ben Hartley, our engineering manager, wants someone who has shipped firmware on real vehicles. He said solar car people are ideal.
Met Aisha Bello, lead of the Michigan Solar Car team, at the career fair. She said half her team is looking for internships and she'd forward our posting.
Zoe Park from Women in Computing invited me to a resume night in November. I promised to bring two engineers.
Luis Romero at Lakeside Cold Storage is our newest pilot customer. He wants routing that knows loading-dock hours.

card.headline: Recruiter, Routewise
card.about: Hiring embedded engineers for delivery-fleet routing.
